prerequisites: A minimum of 70 ECTS points must have been achieved.

learning_outcomes.text: Students understand the concepts of professional creation of AI software.
Students have the ability to create high-quality AI programs using modern tools.
Students can implement their own AI ideas and defend them against competing approaches.
Students are also able to understand, criticize and complement AI programs from colleagues.

syllabus_topics: The practical semester is an integral part of the study program.
It is supervised by the university and accompanied by courses in accordance with the study plan.
Internships should primarily be carried out in companies in Germany and abroad.
The goal is to gain practical experience in an industrial environment.
Students have the opportunity to get to know various companies during their studies.
assessment_rules: The grade weighting is 30/210. No further details are given.
